_what: OWNER DISPLAY OVERRIDES — figures the owner has ruled the app should SHOW, knowingly differing from what the engine derived. Read by ui/tools/extract_board_view.py at publish time. It reaches the UI bundle and NOTHING ELSE: no engine artifact, no board, no store, no valuation. Deleting an entry reverts the app to the derived figure with no rebuild.
_law: Every entry MUST carry the owner's own words and the derived figure it supersedes. An override with no owner_word is refused at publish, because an undocumented override is indistinguishable from a bug.

pool_pick_value.derived_source: data/rl_build/rl_app_data.json PVC["65"] (the board's baked pool index; the curve artifact carries 237.2, which the board rounds)
pool_pick_value.owner_word: override it to 150 please, noting it's an owner override and knowingly isn't derived.
pool_pick_value.scope: the trade desk's pool item and the Pick value page's pool line — the only two surfaces that read this index
pool_pick_value.why_the_derived_figure_stays: 237.2 is correct and the owner has said so: the pool is not pick 65, it is the whole population off the national curve (national 65+, the rookie draft, the pre-season draft, every pickless mechanism) valued by position with order of selection carrying no value, so it legitimately beats the last national pick at 177.8. The engine keeps deriving it; only the display is overridden.
